issue.title: Where does standalone Sandcastle live, how is it distributed, and which repo pilots it?
issue.body: ## Questions - [x] Where does the code live? - [ ] How is it **distributed**? See the [Sandcastle notes](https://github.com/banked/ask-barry/wiki/Sandcastle) first. ```sh sandcastle run --repo banked/payments ```

parent.title: Wayfinder: run Sandcastle standalone against any Banked repo
